newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: HK's Tsang sees upward climb in property market.
newsitem.headline: HK's Tsang sees upward climb in property market.

text.p: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Thursday property would continue to appreciate in Hong Kong and he saw the current situation as a natural growth pattern.
"There will be on the whole a slightly upward climb, consistent with our economic growth rate," he told a press conference in Wellington.
Tsang described the state of the property market as "very good indeed".
"It will continue to appreciate in Hong Kong," he said.
Tsang said Hong Kong authorities had taken measures, although not draconian ones, to dampen property speculation, and this had brought the market down to earth.
"What we are now seeing is a natural growth pattern," he said.
He said what the Hong Kong government could do was to put land on the market to prevent rentals going through the roof, and this would involve reclamation.
